scene: Beyond the mossy arch, three platform gates lead to bustling city transit lines.
picture: Flat side view on a stone platform along the bottom. The grandfather with his bicycle and plant crate stands at the left. Far left rests the vine-wrapped garden tram. Centre waits the cream-and-red retro streetcar. Far right sits the gleaming silver bento express train, each with lit doors ready.
shown: a green vine-covered garden tram car idling with open doors on the left track
a classic red-and-cream streetcar waiting in the centre with an open folding door
a sleek bullet train with giant bento livery on the far right platform
